on_land_and_shoredistance_review.interpretation: Cross-field counts are review signals only; neither the empirical non-fill footprint nor the marine field verifies an observation's coordinate.
on_land_and_shoredistance_review.shoredistance_unit: Not asserted by this integration record.

repeated_observations.interpretation: Rows sharing coordinates or cells remain distinct biological observations and are not assumed independent.

environmental_coverage_status_definition.empirical_fill_selected_layers: None of the requested fields has a value at this cell; this is an empirical data-availability indicator, not an ocean mask.
environmental_coverage_status_definition.empirical_nonfill_selected_layers: All requested fields have values at this cell; this is an empirical data-availability indicator, not an ocean mask.
environmental_coverage_status_definition.empirical_partial_selected_layers: Some, but not all, requested fields have values at this cell; this is an empirical data-availability indicator, not an ocean mask.
environmental_coverage_status_definition.not_assessed: No raster cell was selected because the observation coordinate was invalid or outside the raster extent.

raster_match_status_definitions.extraction_error: A row-specific coordinate-to-array extraction failed; the observation is retained and values are null.
raster_match_status_definitions.invalid_observation_coordinate: Latitude or longitude is absent, non-finite, or outside its valid WGS84 range.
raster_match_status_definitions.masked_raster_cell: The selected cell has no non-missing value in any of the 11 requested environmental fields.
raster_match_status_definitions.matched: A grid cell was selected and all 11 requested environmental values are non-missing.
raster_match_status_definitions.missing_required_environmental_value: The selected cell has at least one but fewer than 11 requested values available.
raster_match_status_definitions.outside_raster_extent: The finite WGS84 point lies outside the outer half-cell boundaries of the raster.
